jobs.title: Director, Clinical Product Management
jobs.description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle.  Visit h1.co to learn more about us.
H1 is partnering with a leading Danish pharmaceutical company to build and lead the product organization for an internal clinical data platform that powers trial design, site selection, and study operations across NN's global R&D function. This role sits at the center of that engagement—a rare opportunity to own a meaningful product inside one of the world's largest and most innovative pharmaceutical companies, operating with the speed and accountability of a startup.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1
As Director, Product Management, you will execute and align the product roadmap and strategy for a clinical data platform used by one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in Denmark organization globally. You will operate in a client-embedded model, working daily with NN stakeholders while reporting into H1's product leadership. This is a build role: the platform is growing, the team is forming, and you will shape both.
You will:
- Execute on the StudyHub product roadmap, aligning clinical and operational priorities with H1's technical capabilities
- Partner closely with client stakeholders—including clinical operations, data science, and digital leadership—to surface requirements, validate direction, and maintain trust
- Lead discovery and delivery cycles with a cross-functional team including engineers, data analysts, UI/UX designers, and AI scientists
- Translate complex clinical data workflows into clear, prioritized product requirements that engineering can execute against
- Establish product metrics, track adoption, and drive continuous improvement based on user feedback and usage data
- Represent the product to senior stakeholders at both H1 and Novo Nordisk; communicate tradeoffs and decisions with clarity and conviction
- Contribute to H1's broader product strategy and serve as a practitioner-leader in H1's growing Copenhagen presence
- Support hiring and onboarding of additional product team members as the engagement scales
 
ABOUT YOU
You're a senior product leader who has shipped data products in complex, regulated, or enterprise environments—and you know how to earn trust with technical and clinical stakeholders alike. You've also operated in a startup or high-growth environment and are comfortable with ambiguity, tight resources, and end-to-end ownership. You think in systems, have the judgment to know when to push and when to align, and you're excited by the intersection of healthcare data and AI.
 
REQUIREMENTS
- 7+ years in product management, with at least 2 years at the Associate Director or Director level or leading a product area end-to-end
- Demonstrated experience building or managing data products—pipelines, dashboards, analytics platforms, or clinical/research data tools
- Track record of effective stakeholder management in enterprise or client-embedded environments
- Pharma, clinical research, or health data domain experience; ability to engage credibly with clinical ops and R&D stakeholders
- Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment; comfort with high ambiguity and direct ownership
- Fluent English required; Danish or other Scandinavian language a plus
- Based in Copenhagen or willing to relocate; existing right-to-work in Denmark strongly preferred
- Comfortable operating across US and European time zones

H1 OFFERS
- Competitive salary + equity (RSUs)
- 5 weeks paid vacation + unlimited additional PTO days and company-wide wellness days
- Pension with employer match
- Health, mobile phone & home office stipends
- A culture built on hygge — low hierarchy, high trust, and real autonomy over your work
- Monthly team social (søbar)
- Direct embed with one of the world's top 20 pharmaceutical companies, working on a global initiative with real impact on how clinical research gets done
- Exposure to H1's broader life sciences client network across biotech, pharma, and digital health

The Product team at H1 builds data intelligence tools used by commercial, medical affairs, and clinical teams across the world's largest pharmaceutical and biotech companies. This Group Product Manager role sits at the intersection of clinical domain expertise and product leadership — you will own a product area within H1's clinical intelligence suite and lead a team of PMs working to bring that vision to life.

WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1
As Group Product Manager, Clinical, you will set strategy, lead a team, and drive execution across H1's clinical data products. You will work directly with clinical stakeholders, data science, engineering, and commercial leadership to define what we build and why.

You will:
- Own the product strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for H1's clinical data product area, balancing customer commitments with long-term platform investment
- Lead, develop, and support a team of 2–4 product managers — running roadmap reviews, facilitating prioritization, and owning their growth and performance
- Drive discovery with clinical stakeholders including physicians, medical affairs leads, and health system buyers to surface unmet needs and validate solutions
- Translate complex clinical workflows and HCP user needs into structured, actionable product requirements for engineering and design
- Partner with data science to bring new clinical datasets, models, and signals into production in ways that are reliable and user-facing
- Define success metrics for your product area and own reporting on engagement, data quality, and clinical user satisfaction
- Establish and maintain team rituals — sprint planning, backlog grooming, roadmap reviews, and retrospectives — and hold the bar on delivery quality
- Represent the product in executive reviews and client-facing conversations as the domain authority for clinical intelligence
- Collaborate with commercial and customer success teams to ensure clinical product investments support retention and expansion goals
- Identify and address gaps in data coverage, interoperability, or clinical workflow alignment that limit adoption or trust in H1's clinical products
 
ABOUT YOU
You have a clinical background — through training, practice, or deep embedded experience in clinical health IT — and you have converted that domain expertise into product leadership. You are comfortable managing a team through ambiguity and holding the line on prioritization when everything feels urgent. You lead with context, not directives.

- A people manager who has led at least 1–2 PMs through full product cycles, including roadmap ownership, stakeholder alignment, and performance calibration
- Clinically credentialed or equivalent in depth: MD, PharmD, NP, PA, RN, MPH, or 5+ years embedded in clinical health IT or real-world evidence
- Experienced shipping B2B data products to healthcare or life sciences buyers, with demonstrable ownership of outcomes — not just delivery
- Fluent in clinical data standards (ICD, CPT, SNOMED, RxNorm) and their practical implications for product design and data quality
- A strong communicator who can adjust register for clinical SMEs, engineering leads, and executive stakeholders without losing precision
- Energized by complexity and comfortable making consequential tradeoffs in ambiguous environments

REQUIREMENTS
- Clinical credential or equivalent depth: MD, PharmD, NP, PA, RN, MPH, or 5+ years in clinical health IT or real-world evidence
- People management: 1+ years managing product managers, with ownership of their roadmaps, priorities, and growth
- B2B product experience: 5+ years in product management, preferably on data-intensive or analytics products in healthcare or life sciences
- Clinical data familiarity: Working knowledge of ICD, CPT, SNOMED, RxNorm, or equivalent clinical standards in a product context
- Stakeholder fluency: Proven ability to drive alignment across clinical, engineering, data science, and commercial functions
- Data and analysis skills: Comfortable using data to validate product decisions; SQL or Python experience a strong plus

You'll bring both the technical depth to engage credibly in the data layer and the leadership presence to set direction, align stakeholders, and build toward a scalable data product architecture.

You think in data and content, not features. You've owned complex data pipelines in regulated environments and have the scar tissue to prove it.  You can build a tracker, run a SQL query, write a vendor SLA, and present a strategy deck — and you know which of those to lead with in any given room. jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Doctor & Research Site Profiles
jobs.description:
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us.
H1 is building the "LinkedIn of medicine" - a two-sided provider network where healthcare professionals and research sites claim their profiles, share their expertise, and connect with sponsors, life science companies, and patients. We've shipped the first chapter: Site Network (trials.h1.co), which lets research sites find themselves on H1 and submit their capabilities, and public doctor profiles (profiles.h1.co), which lets HCPs take ownership of their H1 presence. 
Now we're writing the next chapter: giving every provider a concrete, workflow-level reason to claim and maintain their profile - including credentialing and provider-onboarding services built with industry partners - and turning a claimed profile from a page on the internet into infrastructure providers depend on. We need a Senior PM to own the activation, growth, and product evolution of this network.
As part of H1’s hiring process, all candidates are required to participate in an in-person final interview. Depending on your location, this may require travel.
WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1
As the Senior PM for Hospital & Doctor Profiles, you will own the full lifecycle of our provider activation products - from getting the first HCP or site to claim their profile, to building the services and operations that turn a cold network into a thriving marketplace. You'll sit at the intersection of product, commercial, and operations, partnering closely with engineering, design, marketing, legal, and external partners to build something that doesn't yet exist anywhere else in healthcare.
Own outreach and activation - Build and scale a repeatable motion to engage HCPs and research sites, educate them on the value of claiming their profile, and convert them into fully onboarded platform participants.
Build provider-facing credentialing workflows - Design and launch credentialing and provider-onboarding services, working with independent practice association (IPA) partners and health plan delegation models, that make claiming and maintaining an H1 profile the obvious choice for a busy provider.
Operate in a regulated environment - Partner with legal and compliance to build workflows that are audit-ready and meet health plan and regulatory requirements from day one.
Crack the research site value proposition - Define what makes a research site claim and actively maintain its profile - from being found by sponsors to trial matching and beyond - and turn that into shipped product.
Close the feedback loop between providers and product - Synthesize friction points, workflow nuances, and adoption blockers from provider interactions into actionable product requirements that materially improve sign-up velocity and conversion.
Manage the product roadmap - Partner with design and engineering to define and ship the roadmap for Claim a Profile, Site Network, and our emerging provider services, prioritizing features that grow both sides of the marketplace.
Serve as the internal voice of the ecosystem - Shape roadmap priorities, influence GTM strategy, and ensure the platform evolves in alignment with real-world clinician and site coordinator workflows.
Partner cross-functionally - Unlock growth levers via HCP landing page optimization and data completeness initiatives in close partnership with Marketing, Legal, CS, and Commercial.
Drive long-term value creation - Identify new revenue models and expansion paths as the provider network scales, including business models for provider-facing services, partnering with product and business leadership to build monetization into the platform's foundation.
Track, report, and iterate on activation metrics - Synthesize insights from provider calls, UX feedback, and platform data into clear metrics and prioritization decisions that demonstrate network health and inform leadership.
ABOUT YOU
You have a strong point of view on what good looks like in a marketplace or network-effects product, and you know how to build both sides simultaneously.
You've built zero-to-one products that pair software with a real service or operational component - you're as comfortable designing a workflow and its unit-level metrics as you are writing a PRD.
You're comfortable in ambiguity - you build structure where none exists and move fast without a fully defined playbook.
You're fluent in, or eager to go deep on, the operational realities of healthcare - credentialing, enrollment, payer-provider data flows - and you're energized by regulated, compliance-heavy problem spaces.
You lead with empathy for the end user (HCPs, site coordinators, clinical staff) and hold high standards for product quality and execution rigor.
You're equally energized by hands-on activation work and longer-horizon product strategy, and you don't wait to be told which one needs attention.
You communicate with clarity and conviction - with engineers, with commercial teams, and with executives.
 
REQUIREMENTS 
5+ years of product management experience in healthcare, life sciences, or B2B SaaS
Demonstrated experience owning a product with marketplace or network dynamics
Experience building zero-to-one products that pair software with a service or operational component
Track record of translating user research and operational feedback into shipped, measurable product
Strong cross-functional influence - able to align engineering, design, legal, marketing, and commercial teams around shared outcomes
Familiarity with healthcare data (HCP records, NPI, clinical trial infrastructure) is a strong plus
Familiarity with provider credentialing, enrollment, or payer-provider workflows (delegation models, IPA structures, NCQA/CMS requirements) is a strong plus
Experience with go-to-market strategy for early-stage or net-new products preferred
Clinical trial ecosystem experience is a plus
 
 
COMPENSATION
